Jun's visibility has no bearing on past season rankings.
Being easily spotted doesn't affect whether Jun or Alma seemed relaxed.
Jun's visibility has no connection to Gus's age relative to Zeno.
Jun being spotted from across the water is unrelated to the crews pushing off at the starting horn.
Jun's visibility doesn't relate to the description of oars moving in unison.
